Visibility & Public Action Controls

☁️ Permanent Cloud Storage & Hosting Setup (So Data Never Resets on Refresh)

Choose any of the 3 methods below so your uploaded Excel files and Admin changes stay permanently saved for all visitors on every refresh.

Method 1 • Easiest (No Database Needed)

Bake Uploaded Excel Data Directly Into index.html

Upload your Excel file(s) first, then click the button on the right. It downloads a single index.html with all your records permanently embedded inside the file. Upload that index.html to Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages.

Method 2 • Direct GitHub Pages Live Sync

Push Uploaded Excel Data Directly to Your GitHub Repository

If you host this site on GitHub Pages, enter your repo details below. Clicking Push Data to GitHub commits portal_data.json straight to your repo so every visitor automatically loads the latest data on refresh.

Method 3 • Real-Time Cloud Database (Firebase)

Connect Free Google Firebase Realtime Database

Paste your Firebase Realtime Database URL (e.g. https://your-project-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com). Every Excel upload and Admin change will sync live to the cloud automatically.

🔒

Enter Admin PIN

Enter your administrator PIN to unlock the website control panel. (Default PIN: 2026)
